verses.geez: ግብር፡ ትሩፍ፡ ኢወሊድ፡ ምስለ፡ ኂሩት፡ እስመ፡ ዝክራ፡ ኢመዊት፡ ውእቱ፡ እስመ፡ እምርት፡ ይእቲ፡ በኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር።
verses.translation: Better it is to have no children, and to have virtue: for the memorial thereof is immortal: because it is known with God, and with men.

translations.lxx: Better it is to have no children, and to have virtue: for the memorial thereof is immortal: because it is known with God, and with men.
translations.ron: Mai bine este să nu ai copii, dar să ai bunătate, căci pomenirea bunătăţii este nemuritoare; şi Dumnezeu o ştie şi oamenii o cunosc.
translations.grk: Κρείσσων ἀτεκνία μετὰ ἀρετῆς, ἀθανασία γάρ ἐστιν ἐν μνήμῃ αὐτῆς, ὅτι καὶ παρὰ Θεῷ γινώσκεται καὶ παρὰ ἀνθρώποις·

verses.geez: ወበኀበ፡ ሰብእኒ፡ ያከብርዋ፡ እንዘ፡ ሀለወት፡ ወኅሊፋኒ፡ ይፈትውጥ፡ ወያፈቅርዋ፡ ወበዝንቱ፡ ዓለም፡ አክሊለ፡ ተቀጺላ፡ ታንሶሱ፡ ዘኢይጸመሂ፡ ገድለ፡ መዊዕ።
verses.translation: When it is present, men take example at it; and when it is gone, they desire it: it weareth a crown, and triumpheth for ever, having gotten the victory, striving for undefiled rewards.

translations.lxx: When it is present, men take example at it; and when it is gone, they desire it: it weareth a crown, and triumpheth for ever, having gotten the victory, striving for undefiled rewards.
translations.ron: Când este de faţă, o urmezi şi când s-a dus, îţi pare rău după ea. Bunătatea poartă veşnică cunună, veşnic biruitoare, ieşind fără pată din lupte câştigate.
translations.grk: παροῦσάν τε μιμοῦνται αὐτὴν, καὶ ποθοῦσιν ἀπελθοῦσαν καὶ ἐν τῷ αἰῶνι στεφανηφοροῦσα πομπεύει, τὸν τῶν ἀμιάντων ἄθλων ἀγῶνα νικήσασα.

verses.geez: ብዝኀ፡ ትውልደ፡ ረሲዐን፡ ኢይበቊዕ፡ ወለከንቱ፡ ተክል፡ ኢይትአመር፡ ላቲ፡ ሥርዋ፡ ወኢትግበር፡ ጽኑዐ፡ መንበረ።
verses.translation: But the multiplying brood of the ungodly shall not thrive, nor take deep rooting from bastard slips, nor lay any fast foundation.

translations.lxx: But the multiplying brood of the ungodly shall not thrive, nor take deep rooting from bastard slips, nor lay any fast foundation.
translations.ron: Mulţimea pruncilor la cei nelegiuiţi nu este de nici un folos; din mlădiţele lor spurcate nu se va înfige rădăcină în adânc şi nu vor avea temei nezdruncinat.
translations.grk: Πολύγονον δὲ ἀσεβῶν πλῆθος οὐ χρησιμεύσει, καὶ ἐκ νόθων μοσχευμάτων οὐ δώσει ῥίζαν εἰς βάθος, οὐδὲ ἀσφαλῆ βάσιν ἑδράσει.

verses.geez: ወእመኒ፡ ጊዜ፡ ሠርዐ፡ ውስተ፡ አዕፁቂሃ፡ ቈጽል፡ ጽኑዕ፡ እንዘ፡ ኢይልህቅ፡ ያንቀለቅሎ፡ ነፋስ፡ ወበኃይለ፡ ነፋስ፡ ይትመላኅ።
verses.translation: For though they flourish in branches for a time; yet standing not fast, they shall be shaken with the wind, and through the force of winds they shall be rooted out.

translations.lxx: For though they flourish in branches for a time; yet standing not fast, they shall be shaken with the wind, and through the force of winds they shall be rooted out.
translations.ron: Chiar dacă se vor îmbrăca vremelnic întru ramuri, fiind fără temeinicie, se vor zgudui de vânt şi se vor dezrădăcina de puterea vijeliei.
translations.grk: Κᾂν γὰρ ἐν κλάδοις πρὸς καιρὸν ἀναθάλῃ, ἐπισφαλῶς βεβηκότα ὑπὸ ἀνέμου σαλευθήσεται, καὶ ὑπὸ βίας ἀνέμων ἐκριζωθήσεται.

verses.geez: ወይሰበሩ፡ አዕፁቂሃ፡ እንዘ፡ ኢኮኑ፡ ፍጹማነ፡ ወፍሬሆሙኒ፡ ቆዕ፡ ከንቱ፡ ዘኢይደሉ፡ ለበሊዕ፡ እስመ፡ ኢኮነ፡ ጊዜሁ፡ ወለምንትኒ፡ ኢይበቊዕ።
verses.translation: The imperfect branches shall be broken off, their fruit unprofitable, not ripe to eat, yea, meet for nothing.

translations.lxx: The imperfect branches shall be broken off, their fruit unprofitable, not ripe to eat, yea, meet for nothing.
translations.ron: Ramurile lor vor fi frânte mai înainte de vârsta deplină, rodul lor va fi netrebnic, crud la mâncare şi de nimic bun,
translations.grk: Περικλασθήσονται κλῶνες ἀτέλεστοι, καὶ ὁ καρπὸς αὐτῶν ἄχρηστος, ἄωρος εἰς βρῶσιν, καὶ εἰς οὐθὲν ἐπιτήδειος.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ውሉድ፡ እለ፡ ይትወለዱ፡ እምእኩያን፡ ሰማዕት፡ እሙንቱ፡ ለእከየ፡ አዝማዲሆሙ፡ በሐተታሆሙ።
verses.translation: For children begotten of unlawful beds are witnesses of wickedness against their parents in their trial.

translations.lxx: For children begotten of unlawful beds are witnesses of wickedness against their parents in their trial.
translations.ron: Fiindcă pruncii născuţi din somnul necurat sunt martori ai nelegiuirii părinţilor, când stai să-i cercetezi.
translations.grk: Ἐκ γὰρ ἀνόμων ὕπνων τέκνα γεννώμενα μάρτυρές εἰσι πονηρίας κατὰ γονέων ἐν ἐξετασμῷ αὐτῶν.

verses.geez: ጻድቅሰ፡ አመ፡ በጽሐ፡ ጊዜሁ፡ ለመዊት፡ ይሄሉ፡ በዕረፍት።
verses.translation: But though the righteous be prevented with death, yet shall he be in rest.

translations.lxx: But though the righteous be prevented with death, yet shall he be in rest.
translations.ron: Cel drept, chiar când apucă să moară mai devreme, dă de odihnă.
translations.grk: Δίκαιος δὲ ἐὰν φθάσῃ τελευτῆσαι, ἐν ἀναπαύσει ἔσται.

verses.geez: ክብረ፡ ርእስ፡ አኮ፡ በብዝኀ፡ መዋዕል፡ ወአኮ፡ በኊልቈ፡ ዓመታት።
verses.translation: For honourable age is not that which standeth in length of time, nor that is measured by number of years.

translations.lxx: For honourable age is not that which standeth in length of time, nor that is measured by number of years.
translations.ron: Bătrâneţile cinstite nu sunt cele aduse de o viaţă lungă, nici nu le măsori după numărul anilor.
translations.grk: Γῆρας γὰρ τίμιον οὐ τὸ πολυχρόνιον, οὐδὲ ἀριθμῷ ἐτῶν μεμέτρηται.

verses.geez: ሲባትሰ፡ አእምሮቱ፡ ለብእሲ፡ ውእቱ፡ ወአክሊለ፡ ለርእስ፡ ግእዝ፡ ዘእንበለ፡ ነውር።
verses.translation: But wisdom is the grey hair unto men, and an unspotted life is old age.

translations.lxx: But wisdom is the grey hair unto men, and an unspotted life is old age.
translations.ron: Înţelepciunea este la om adevărata cărunteţe şi vârsta bătrâneţilor înseamnă o viaţă neîntinată.
translations.grk: Πολιὰ δέ ἐστιν φρόνησις ἀνθρώποις, καὶ ἡλικία γήρως βίος ἀκηλίδωτος.

verses.geez: መሥመሬ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ዘኮነ፡ ይትፈቀር፡ ወእንዘ፡ የሐዩ፡ ማእከለ፡ ኃጥአን፡ ይፈልስ፡ ወይትመሰጥ፡ እምቅድመ፡ ትሚጥ፡ እኪት፡ አእምሮቶ፡ አው፡ እመ፡ አኮ፡ ኅብል፡ ኢታስፍጥ፡ ነፍሶ።
verses.translation: He pleased God, and was beloved of him: so that living among sinners he was translated.

translations.lxx: He pleased God, and was beloved of him: so that living among sinners he was translated.
translations.ron: Plăcut fiind lui Dumnezeu, Domnul l-a iubit şi, fiindcă trăia între păcătoşi, l-a mutat de pe pământ.
translations.grk: Εὐάρεστος τῷ Θεῷ γενόμενος ἠγαπήθη, καὶ ζῶν μεταξὺ ἁμαρτωλῶν μετετέθη.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ቅንአተ፡ እከይ፡ ያጸልም፡ ሠናያተ፡ ወንዝህላለ፡ ፍትወት፡ ያፈልስ፡ ልበ፡ የዋሀን።
verses.translation: Yea, speedily was he taken away, lest that wickedness should alter his understanding, or deceit beguile his soul.

translations.lxx: Yea, speedily was he taken away, lest that wickedness should alter his understanding, or deceit beguile his soul.
translations.ron: A fost răpit, ca răutatea să nu-i schimbe mintea sa, înşelăciunea să nu-i amăgească sufletul.
translations.grk: Ἡρπάγη μὴ κακία ἀλλάξῃ σύνεσιν αὐτοῦ, ἢ δόλος ἀπατήσῃ ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: ወለእመኒ፡ ሞተ፡ በኅዳጥ፡ መዋዕል፡ ፈጸመ፡ ዓመታተ፡ ነዋኀ፡ እስመ፡ ሀለወት፡ ነፍሱ፡ ሥምርተ፡ በኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር።
verses.translation: For the bewitching of naughtiness doth obscure things that are honest; and the wandering of concupiscence doth undermine the simple mind.

translations.lxx: For the bewitching of naughtiness doth obscure things that are honest; and the wandering of concupiscence doth undermine the simple mind.
translations.ron: Căci vraja viciului întunecă cele bune şi ameţeala poftei schimbă gândul cel fără de răutate.
translations.grk: Βασκανία γὰρ φαυλότητος ἀμαυροῖ τὰ καλὰ, καὶ ῥεμβασμὸς ἐπιθυμίας μεταλλεύει νοῦν ἄκακον.

verses.geez: ወበእንዝ፡ ጐጒዐ፡ ወሖረ፡ እማእከለ፡ ጹግ፡ ወነኪራንሰ፡ ርእዮሙ፡ ዘንተ፡ ኢለበውዎ፡ ወኢያስተጋብኡ፡ ውስተ፡ ሕሊናሆሙ፡ ፍካሬሁ፡ ለዝ።
verses.translation: He, being made perfect in a short time, fulfilled a long time:

translations.lxx: He, being made perfect in a short time, fulfilled a long time:
translations.ron: Ajungând curând la desăvârşire, dreptul a apucat ani îndelungaţi.
translations.grk: Τελειωθεὶς ἐν ὀλίγῳ ἐπλήρωσε χρόνους μακρούς.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ፍትሑ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ ውእቱ፡ ለጻድቃኒሁ፡ ወሕዋፄሁ፡ በሣህል፡ ይከውን፡ ላዕለ፡ ኅሩያኒሁ።
verses.translation: for his soul pleased the Lord: therefore hasted he to take him away from among the wicked.

translations.lxx: for his soul pleased the Lord: therefore hasted he to take him away from among the wicked.
translations.ron: Sufletul lui era plăcut lui Dumnezeu, pentru aceasta Domnul S-a grăbit să-l scoată din mijlocul răutăţii.
translations.grk: Ἀρεστὴ γὰρ ἦν Κυρίῳ ἡ ψυχὴ αὐτοῦ· διὰ τοῦτο ἔσπευσεν ἐκ μέσου πονηρίας.

verses.geez: ወብእሲሰ፡ ጻድቅ፡ መዊቶ፡ ይኴንን፡ ረሲዓነ፡ እንዘ፡ ሀለዉ፡ ሕያዋኒሆሙ፡ ወወሬዛሂ፡ ሶበ፡ ሞተ፡ ፍጡነ፡ ይኴንን፡ ረሲዓነ፡ ዓመታተ፡ ርስዕ፡ ዘዓመፃ።
verses.translation: This the people saw, and understood not, neither laid they up this in their minds, That his grace and mercy is with his saints, and that he hath respect unto his chosen.

translations.lxx: This the people saw, and understood not, neither laid they up this in their minds, That his grace and mercy is with his saints, and that he hath respect unto his chosen.
translations.ron: Neamurile văd, dar nu pricep nimic şi nu-şi bat capul cu aşa ceva, că adică harul lui Dumnezeu şi mila Lui sunt cu aleşii Săi şi că poartă grijă de sfinţii Săi.
translations.grk: Οἱ δὲ λαοὶ ἰδόντες καὶ μὴ νοήσαντες, μηδὲ θέντες ἐπὶ διανοίᾳ τὸ τοιοῦτο, ὅτι χάρις καὶ ἔλεος ἐν τοῖς ἐκλεκτοῖς αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἐπισκοπὴ ἐν τοῖς ὁσίοις αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ይሬእዩ፡ ሙተተ፡ ጻድቅ፡ ጠቢብ፡ ወኢይሌብዉ፡ ወኢየአምሩ፡ ምንተ፡ መከረ፡ በእንቲአሁ፡ ወለምንት፡ አስተጋብኦ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ኀቤሁ፡ ወይሬእይዎ፡ ወይትቃጸቡ፡ ቦቱ።
verses.translation: Thus the righteous that is dead shall condemn the ungodly which are living; and youth that is soon perfected the many years and old age of the unrighteous.

translations.lxx: Thus the righteous that is dead shall condemn the ungodly which are living; and youth that is soon perfected the many years and old age of the unrighteous.
translations.ron: Dreptul care moare osândeşte pe nelegiuiţii care trăiesc, iar tinereţea ajunsă la grabnică desăvârşire osândeşte lungile bătrâneţi ale celui nedrept.
translations.grk: Κατακρινεῖ δὲ δίκαιος καμὼν τοῦς ζῶντας ἀσεβεῖς, καὶ νεότης τελεσθεῖσα ταχέως πολυετὲς γῆρας ἀδίκου.

verses.geez: ወኪያሆሙሳ፡ ይስሕቆሙ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ወይከውኑ፡ እምድኅረዝ፡ ለድቀት፡ ኅሡር፡ ወለጽእለተ፡ ሙታን፡ ዘለዓለም።
verses.translation: For they shall see the end of the wise, and shall not understand what God in his counsel hath decreed of him, and to what end the Lord hath set him in safety.

translations.lxx: For they shall see the end of the wise, and shall not understand what God in his counsel hath decreed of him, and to what end the Lord hath set him in safety.
translations.ron: Vor vedea sfârşitul înţeleptului, dar nu vor înţelege ce sfat a avut Dumnezeu cu el şi pentru ce l-a pus bine pentru Sine.
translations.grk: Ὄψονται γὰρ τελευτὴν σοφοῦ, καὶ οὐ νοήσουσι τί ἐβουλεύσατο περὶ αὐτοῦ, καὶ εἰς τί ἠσφαλίσατο αὐτὸν ὁ Κύριος.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ይመትሮሙ፡ ወያነቅዖሙ፡ ወይትፈከቡ፡ ውዱቃነ፡ በገጾሙ፡ እንዘ፡ አልቦሙ፡ ቃል።
verses.translation: They shall see him, and despise him; but God shall laugh them to scorn; and they shall hereafter be a vile carcase, and a reproach among the dead for evermore.

translations.lxx: They shall see him, and despise him; but God shall laugh them to scorn; and they shall hereafter be a vile carcase, and a reproach among the dead for evermore.
translations.ron: Vor vedea şi-şi vor bate joc, dar Domnul îi va face de ocară.
translations.grk: Ὄψονται καὶ ἐξουθενήσουσιν, αὐτοὺς δὲ ὁ Κύριος ἐκγελάσεται· καὶ ἔσονται μετὰ τοῦτο εἰς πτῶμα ἄτιμον, καὶ εἰς ὕβριν ἐν νεκροῖς διʼ αἰῶνος.

verses.geez: ወየሀውኮሙ፡ እምሥርዎሙ፡ ወለዝሉፉ፡ ይከውኑ፡ ከመ፡ ምድር፡ ብድውት፡ ወይከውኑ፡ ጽዑራነ፡ ወዝክሮሙ፡ ይትኀጐል።
verses.translation: For he shall rend them, and cast them down headlong, that they shall be speechless; and he shall shake them from the foundation; and they shall be utterly laid waste, and be in sorrow; and their memorial shall perish.

translations.lxx: For he shall rend them, and cast them down headlong, that they shall be speechless; and he shall shake them from the foundation; and they shall be utterly laid waste, and be in sorrow; and their memorial shall perish.
translations.ron: Căci vor fi pe urmă hoit fără de cinste, printre morţi, întru ruşine, în veac de veac; Domnul îi va zdrobi şi, muţi, îi va azvârli cu capul în jos, îi va zgudui din temelie şi vor pieri până la cel mai mic; chinul îi va măcina şi pomenirea lor se va şterge.
translations.grk: Ὅτι ῥήξει αὐτοὺς ἀφώνους πρηνεῖς, καὶ σαλεύσει αὐτοὺς ἐκ θεμελίων, καὶ ἕως ἐσχάτου χερσωθήσονται, καὶ ἔσονται ἐν ὀδύνῃ, καὶ ἡ μνήμη αὐτῶν ἀπολεῖται.

verses.geez: ወይቀርቡ፡ ለቅስተ፡ ኃጢአቶሙ፡ ፍሩሃነ፡ ወይዛለፎሙ፡ ገሃደ፡ በአንፃሪሆሙ፡ ኃጢአቶሙ።
verses.translation: And when they cast up the account of their sins, they shall come with fear: and their own iniquities shall convince them to their face.

translations.lxx: And when they cast up the account of their sins, they shall come with fear: and their own iniquities shall convince them to their face.
translations.ron: Vor veni înspăimântaţi de ştiinţa păcatelor lor şi fărădelegile lor îi vor mustra faţă în faţă.
translations.grk: Ἐλεύσονται ἐν συλλογισμῷ ἁμαρτημάτων αὐτῶν δειλοὶ, καὶ ἐλέγξει αὐτοὺς ἐξεναντίας τὰ ἀνομήματα αὐτῶν.
